title: Transformers.js ONNX Pipeline Plan
description: A structured plan for a Transformers.js integration -- pipeline type, environment, caching, and logits-access decisions -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/transformers_js_onnx_pipelines_audit.mjs.

pipelineType.description: The shape of the pipeline: sentence embeddings (bi-encoder), (query, candidate) reranking (cross-encoder), or single-input classification.

runsInCI.description: Whether this pipeline is also exercised in CI (tests, corpus builds).

usesHighLevelPipeline.description: True if the integration goes through pipeline() rather than AutoTokenizer + AutoModel* directly.

readsRawLogits.description: True if scores are read from outputs.logits.data directly (required for single-logit cross-encoder heads).

maxCandidateTokens.description: Upper bound on candidate text length in tokens fed to a cross-encoder; must fit the 512-token joint (query, candidate) limit.

pooling.description: Exact versioned pooling recipe used for bi-encoder sentence embeddings; generic mean/cls labels are insufficient.

normalizeEmbeddings.description: True if embeddings are L2-normalized so cosine equals dot product.

loaderModelId.description: Exact model id passed to the loader; for a bi-encoder it must equal embeddingProfile.modelId.

loaderRevision.description: Exact immutable revision passed to the loader; for a bi-encoder it must equal embeddingProfile.modelRevision.

maxInputTokens.description: Token limit actually used by the embedding invocation; it must equal embeddingProfile.maxTokens.

spaceId.description: Opaque declared-space id emitted by the canonical registry. Consumers do not rederive it, and it is not ResourceScope compatibility proof.

quality.description: Current registry rows remain degraded until separate attestation evidence promotes them.

embeddingProfile.description: Complete canonical v2 declared-space profile supplied by the registry. The audit checks shape and loader alignment but never reimplements its digests or treats it as producer attestation.

modelSelectedByDomainEval.description: Evidence annotation only. It does not promote a declarative registry profile or authorize an approved quality state.

rejectsIncompatibleSpaces.description: Records the fail-closed requirement for a future separately attested comparison path; it does not authorize comparison now.

vectorDisposition.description: Required disposition for vectors emitted from a declarative-only profile. Ordinary index persistence is forbidden.

similarityComparisonEnabled.description: Must be false for declarative-only profiles because this skill has no producer-attestation verifier.

lazyLoadPromiseCached.description: True if the model load Promise is created lazily inside a function and cached so concurrent first calls share one download.

allowLocalModels.description: The value of env.allowLocalModels. Must be false in CI or the SDK fails looking for on-disk model files.

cacheDirConfigured.description: True if env.cacheDir is set to an explicit, controllable path.

ciCachePersisted.description: True if the model cache directory is persisted across CI runs (e.g. actions/cache).

persistsVectors.description: True only for an explicit quarantined-uncompared artifact; declarative-only vectors cannot enter an ordinary index.

copiesOutputBuffer.description: True if outputs are copied on capture (new Float32Array(out.data)) rather than holding a view into a reused tensor buffer.

modelVersionPinned.description: True if the exact model id/revision is pinned in code, never 'latest'.

dtype.description: Transformers.js v4 model-loader dtype. It is intentionally separate from embeddingProfile.coordinatePrecision, coordinateQuantization, and storageQuantization.

fullPrecisionJustified.description: True if a measured accuracy regression justifies full-precision weights over quantized.

ciSmokeTest.description: True if CI runs known inputs and asserts load success, dimensions, and finite coordinates without similarity comparison.
